offence_note: Assault, break and enter, uttering forged documents, breaches of recognizance and probation
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed and the custodial sentence is reduced to time served [thirteen days]. The probation order imposed by the trial judge will stand.
note: Jail reduced from three months to time served.

offence_note: Dangerous operation of motor vehicle and flight from police
sentence_quote: I would impose an additional 18 months’ less a day incarceration. [56] All other aspects of the respondent’s original sentence remain the same.
note: Additional 18 months less a day on top of 6 months already served; total not stated; driving prohibition not shown.

offence_note: Assaulting a peace officer and theft under $5,000
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal and allow the appeal only to the extent of deleting the terms of probation.
note: Six months for assault, one day for theft; probation deleted because offender serving over two years.

offence_note: Robbery, dangerous driving causing bodily harm, driving while prohibited, failing to stop
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to a period of incarceration totaling six years (2,190 days), reduced to 639 days after he was credited with 1,551 days for his time spent in pre-sentence custody.
systemic_quote: the sentencing judge expressly noted that she was taking into account “the obvious applicability of the Gladue features in this case” as a mitigating factor
note: Appeal only about pre-sentence custody credit; ancillary orders not detailed.

offence_note: Sexual assault by a young person
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted and the appeal is allowed to the extent of quashing the sentence imposed on the breach of probation.
note: Youth sentence with secure custody; length not shown. Only breach of probation sentence quashed.

offence_note: Criminal negligence causing bodily harm (shaking infant son)
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal, and reduce the sentence to the four months served to date.
note: Sentence reduced from 12 months to four months served; probation terms varied, length not shown.

offence_note: Dangerous driving causing bodily harm (road rage, ran down victim)
sentence_quote: substituting for the sentence of two years' imprisonment a term of 22 months to be served in the community.
note: Conditional sentence with house arrest replaced two years' imprisonment; prohibitions from trial stand.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; possession of another's ID documents
sentence_quote: Now, these are the terms for the full 18 months for your conditional sentence, Mr. Heidari.
note: 18 month conditional sentence, house arrest 12 months then curfew; 10-year s. 109 prohibition.

offence_note: Weapon dangerous to public peace; firearm possession while prohibited
sentence_quote: the conditional sentence of two years less a day plus three years probation imposed on Mr. Jones after he pleaded guilty
note: Majority dismissed Crown appeal; dissent (Juriansz) would have imposed jail. Conditional sentence length 2 years less a day.

sentence_quote: imposed a suspended sentence for a term of 15 months which included various reporting conditions.
note: Summary conviction appeal dismissed; SOIRA ten years.

offence_note: Offences not stated; similar offences against same victim
sentence_quote: Accordingly leave to appeal sentence is granted but the appeal is dismissed.
note: Lengthy jail sentence at high end of range; length and offences not shown.

offence_note: Aggravated assault of pregnant spouse; obstructing justice
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to the maximum of 14 years imprisonment (less 5 years credit for pre-trial custody and 1 year for his plea of guilty for a net sentence of 8 years) on the charge of aggravated assault
note: One month concurrent for obstructing justice; plea credit one year deducted from the 14 years.
